issue.title: bob gmail sync — label-routed Gmail threads watched for replies until their task closes
issue.description: Labelling a Gmail thread `bob` (plus an optional `#/<note>` or `+/<note>` routing label) files one task into that area or project note and keeps watching the thread until the task is closed: your reply puts the task on an awaiting-reply hold drawn as a hollow paper plane, their reply lifts it and resurfaces the task in the next review, and `bob gmail sync` runs every 15 minutes on the Mac from the chezmoi cron data.

payload.entry: gog header coverage (step 2): gog v0.44.0 (installed on athena) through upstream HEAD v0.48.0+ has NO `--format` flag on `gmail thread get` ("unknown flag --format"); it always calls Threads.Get(...).Format("full"), so every message carries all payload headers (From/To/Cc/Bcc/Auto-Submitted/X-Autoreply/X-Autorespond/Precedence/Content-Type) plus bodies. Bob's Gog::thread_metadata passed `--format metadata`, so bob gmail search, peek, list -r, and send recovery all failed against real gog while the fake accepted the flag. Fixed: thread_metadata now runs plain `gmail thread get <id>` (no --format, no --full); fake gog now rejects `--format` on thread get and serves the metadata scenario when `--full` is absent. The watch phase should fetch watched threads through thread_metadata.

Also fixed a pre-existing mail-note refresh bug: note::parse heading_range/summary_range included the line ending, so every refresh that rewrote title/summary ate one newline; two refreshes fused "# Title" with the Open-in-Gmail line and "· summary" with "## Notes". Ranges now end at content_end (as card header ranges already did); merge test repeated_refreshes_keep_the_blank_lines_around_title_and_summary pins it. Needed because a changed turn alone now triggers a refresh. Vault mail notes checked: none damaged yet.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: gog metadata-only thread read — upstream gog `gmail thread get` has no --format metadata/--headers, so Bob's thread_metadata (search, peek, list -r, send recovery, and the sync watch loop every 15 min) downloads full bodies; propose to openclaw/gogcli adding `--format metadata --headers H1,H2` to `gmail thread get` (needed headers: From, To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, Date, Message-ID, Auto-Submitted, X-Autoreply, X-Autorespond, Precedence, Content-Type), then switch thread_metadata to it behind a version check.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: `gog gmail search --ids-only` needs gog >= v0.48.0 (added in gogcli 6ad392fc, #1257) but Bob's gog gate is >= v0.44.0 and athena runs v0.44.0 ("unknown flag --ids-only") — Gog::search_page (resolve.rs RFC message-ID lookup today, and the planned bob gmail sync paged discovery) fails on older gog; raise the minimum gog to v0.48.0 (or gate the ids-only path) before the sync phase ships, and verify the Mac's gog version.

Verified: new pure src/native/gmail/turn.rs (classify + fold, unit vectors T1-T12 plus marker, ordering, and unproven-direction cases); mail notes write turn/turn_since after messages on save/refresh/link/send promotion (changed turn = refresh, unknown removes both); bob gmail list -f json exposes turn/turn_since (null when absent); mail.base gains the Waiting for reply view (turn == theirs, turn_since ASC, title/who/turn_since/file.backlinks), MAIL_BASE_V1 kept, untouched V1 upgraded only in a write that creates/refreshes a note and is committed, customized base left alone. gog check: thread get has no --format (fixed thread_metadata; fake gog now rejects it); fake-gog contract test tests/gmail_turns.rs drives every classifier header through gog JSON. Also fixed refresh newline loss in note::parse ranges. Docs: gmail.md Save/List/Security, vault-format.md, json-outputs.md. cargo fmt --check, just lint (exit 0, no new warnings), cargo test --workspace (9255 passed, 0 failed), just docs-check all green. payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE: native::gmail::sync::guard::tests::real_lock_contention_and_release flakes (panics 'release frees the guard' at src/native/gmail/sync/guard.rs:206). Proposed by bob-cli-ii.4.1.2; triaged by the bob-cli-ii.4.1 land agent. Introduced by 39122cb2 (bob-cli-ii.3.1.2). Reproduced on the pre-watch base 23217c1d: 3 of 6 'cargo test --lib gmail::' runs failed; also failed 2 of 2 full lib runs on b252669b, and passes alone. Likely mechanism matches closed bob-cli-3t (fixed only for ob.rs by 57a29004): try_acquire uses flock try_lock_exclusive, and a concurrent test thread's fork can briefly inherit the guard fd until exec, so the immediate re-acquire after drop sees WouldBlock. Suggested fix: make the post-drop re-acquire retry within a short bounded window, as 57a29004 did, without weakening the Busy assertion. Not caused by ii.4.1.
